build_DataPipeline: build a python module to run the DataPipeline process method and create input features for a protein variant
create_ProteinVariant: create a ProteinVariant dataclass instance with sequence, position, reference and alternate amino acids
run_Cropper: run the Cropper class to crop and pad protein features to uniform input sizes for the model
build_msa_features: build MSA features from a list of parsed MSA objects using make_msa_features
run_variant_sequence_features: run variant_sequence_features to compute feature dictionary for a single protein variant sequence
